<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Restaurant" targetNamespace="http://example.com/restaurant">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerHandover" name="Buzzer and instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChefOrder" name="New meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealReady" name="Meal placed in service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CallGuest" name="Employee calls guest"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealHandover" name="Meal handover"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Restaurant">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Chef" name="Chef" processRef="Process_Chef"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Places order" sourceRef="Task_GuestPlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerHandover" name="Hands over buzzer and explains signal" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverBuzzer" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChefOrder" name="Informs chef of new order" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeInformChef" targetRef="Task_ChefReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_ChefOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealReady" name="Informs employee meal is ready" sourceRef="Task_ChefInformEmployee" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveReady" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Event_GuestBuzzerRings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CallGuest" name="Calls guest" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeCallGuest" targetRef="Event_GuestCalled" messageRef="Message_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch" sourceRef="Task_GuestArriveAtHatch" targetRef="Event_EmployeeGuestArrives" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealHandover" name="Hands over meal" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveMeal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest meal purchase" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GuestHungry" name="Feeling hungry"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestEnterRestaurant" name="Enter restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestChooseDish" name="Choose a dish from the changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestWaitTurn" name="Wait for turn"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GuestPlaceOrder" name="Place order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer and instructions" messageRef="Message_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_GuestWaitNotification" name="Wait for notification"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GuestBuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_GuestBuzzerRings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GuestCalled" name="Employee calls guest">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_GuestCalled" messageRef="Message_CallGuest"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GuestNotificationMerge" name="Notification received"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestArriveAtHatch" name="Arrive at service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GuestReceiveMeal" name="Receive meal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestEatMeal" name="Eat meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_GuestMealEaten" name="Meal eaten"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_1" sourceRef="Start_GuestHungry" targetRef="Task_GuestEnterRestaurant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_2" sourceRef="Task_GuestEnterRestaurant" targetRef="Task_GuestChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_3" sourceRef="Task_GuestChooseDish" targetRef="Task_GuestWaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_4" sourceRef="Task_GuestWaitTurn" targetRef="Task_GuestPlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_5" sourceRef="Task_GuestPlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_6" sourceRef="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_GuestWaitNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_7" sourceRef="Gateway_GuestWaitNotification" targetRef="Event_GuestBuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_8" sourceRef="Gateway_GuestWaitNotification" targetRef="Event_GuestCalled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_9" sourceRef="Event_GuestBuzzerRings" targetRef="Gateway_GuestNotificationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_10" sourceRef="Event_GuestCalled" targetRef="Gateway_GuestNotificationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_11" sourceRef="Gateway_GuestNotificationMerge" targetRef="Task_GuestArriveAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_12" sourceRef="Task_GuestArriveAtHatch" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_13" sourceRef="Task_GuestReceiveMeal" targetRef="Task_GuestEatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_14" sourceRef="Task_GuestEatMeal" targetRef="End_GuestMealEaten"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee order and service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Employee" name="Ready to serve"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_EmployeeReceiveOrder" name="Receive order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EmployeeEnterPOS" name="Enter order into POS"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeCollectMoney" name="Collect money"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeSetupBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmployeeHandOverBuzzer" name="Hand over buzzer and explain signal" messageRef="Message_BuzzerHandover"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmployeeInformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order" messageRef="Message_ChefOrder"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_EmployeeReceiveReady" name="Receive notice that meal is ready" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EmployeeWaitMerge" name="Wait for guest or call"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_EmployeeWaitArrival" name="Wait for guest arrival or 5 minutes"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_EmployeeGuestArrives" name="Guest arrives at service hatch">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_EmployeeGuestArrives" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_EmployeeFiveMinutes" name="5 minutes pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDef_EmployeeFiveMinutes">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmployeeCallGuest" name="Call guest" messageRef="Message_CallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Employee" name="Meal handed over"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_1" sourceRef="Start_Employee" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_2" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveOrder" targetRef="Task_EmployeeEnterPOS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_3" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeEnterPOS" targetRef="Task_EmployeeCollectMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_4" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeCollectMoney" targetRef="Task_EmployeeSetupBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_5" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeSetupBuzzer" targetRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_6" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverBuzzer" targetRef="Task_EmployeeInformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_7" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeInformChef" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_8" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveReady" targetRef="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_9" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_EmployeeWaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_10" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeCallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_EmployeeWaitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_11" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployeeWaitMerge" targetRef="Gateway_EmployeeWaitArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_12" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployeeWaitArrival" targetRef="Event_EmployeeGuestArrives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_13" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployeeWaitArrival" targetRef="Event_EmployeeFiveMinutes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_14" sourceRef="Event_EmployeeFiveMinutes" targetRef="Task_EmployeeCallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_15" sourceRef="Event_EmployeeGuestArrives" targetRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_16" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal" targetRef="End_Employee"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chef" name="Chef meal preparation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Chef" name="Ready to prepare orders"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ChefReceiveOrder" name="Receive meal order" messageRef="Message_ChefOrder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChefPrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChefPlaceMeal" name="Place meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ChefInformEmployee" name="Inform employee meal is ready" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Chef" name="Employee informed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_1" sourceRef="Start_Chef" targetRef="Task_ChefReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_2" sourceRef="Task_ChefReceiveOrder" targetRef="Task_ChefPrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_3" sourceRef="Task_ChefPrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_ChefPlaceMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_4" sourceRef="Task_ChefPlaceMeal" targetRef="Task_ChefInformEmployee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_5" sourceRef="Task_ChefInformEmployee" targetRef="End_Chef"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
